title: spar-exocortex judge output envelope
description: Output of Step 5 — Judge pass. The judge reads baseline + attacker output + challenger report + execution results and produces this decision envelope. Round-two demand is forbidden on the last permitted round (orchestration validator rejects it).

decision.description: Final decision for this round. demand-round-two is forbidden on the last permitted round per --max-rounds.

decisiveResult.description: Specific execution result that settled the decision (e.g., 'challenger passed attacker-input where baseline timed out'). If reasoning-decisive, use literal string 'no execution decisive — decided on reasoning' and fill reasoningJustification.

reasoningJustification.description: Required iff decisiveResult equals the literal 'no execution decisive — decided on reasoning'. Otherwise omitted.

applicable.description: True iff the problem was flagged ops-critical at domain detection.

wins.description: Required iff applicable=true. Dimensions where the LOSER wins (winner-on-architecture-but-loser-on-X). Empty array means none — explicit 'none' answer.

grafts.description: Required iff applicable=true and wins is non-empty. Concrete grafts from loser → winner, one per wins entry.

rationale.description: Required when wins is empty (the 'no graft needed' justification).

operationalGraft.description: Required iff the problem is ops-critical. Applies the operational-graft hybridization question from /engage-exocortex with attribution.

roundTwoRationale.description: Required iff decision=demand-round-two. Explains what needs stronger pressure in the next round.
